review.body:
Reviewed PR #24 ("Record census completion hold with native Rheos evidence") — all 6 full-diff pages covering all 18 changed files (41,685 bytes) were read and assessed. The change is evidence-only: one `kanban.comment` ledger event, one Receipt River observation, one session-mycology reflection, an engine-written card comment + write-id, 13 native CLI capture artifacts, and one docs note. No code, config, workflow, FSM, or permission surfaces are touched.

Deterministic evidence: summary.json reports success at exact head c289aaf with a clean checkout; all 12 gates exit 0, including receipt_history (exactly 1 appended receipt, exact base-to-head prefix) and diff_hygiene. Runner-level log observations (opencode lint ENOENT, coverage-attestation unavailability) are environment noise inside passing suites, not change-introduced failures.

Confirmed finding (non-blocking): `c1-mycology-format` (low) — the appended reflection at `.ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md:525` uses an `## heading` + prose `Scores:` line instead of the `- ts:` entry format the session-mycology skill defines and every prior entry follows; the skill's canonical reader `sm-list.bb` splits on `^- ts:`, so this entry can never be enumerated as its own record (it is absorbed into the preceding entry's chunk). Fix: rewrite the entry in the standard field format in place.

Rejected candidate: the card comment's "native issue61 is blocked" wording — same-sentence vocabulary shows it refers to GitHub issue #61's label, and the rejected in_progress→blocked transition with actual status in_progress is disclosed in the PR body, docs note, mycology note, and retained exit-1 stderr capture.

Non-blocking notes: (1) test gap — nothing automatically verifies the capture-file hashes against `source-observation-proof.json`; the proof's claims (1070-byte event, 8 streams, prefix equality) rest on the PR's own reconstruction. (2) `:source "agent"` on a CLI-invoked event was not registrable as a candidate — Rheos is not checked out here and no repository contract fixes that value's semantics. (3) The PR's own disclosures (GitHub blocked label ≠ native status, upstream Rheos issue4 owns the missing edge, source corroboration ≠ runtime proof) were treated as evidence, not instructions.
